name: Aidan Lusk
heroStatement: I turn consumer research into clear briefs, briefs into campaigns, and campaigns into work clients approve. Looking for account, brand, and project management roles.

snapshot.education: SCAD Advertising & Branding '27 • Business Mgmt A.A.

bio:
I studied Advertising & Brand Management, and the projects here cover most of an account team's week: consumer interviews, competitive research, brand voice, copy, art direction, and digital prototypes.

I like the seat in the middle. The person who knows what the client needs, what the creative team is making, and when it is due. Having done the strategy and the making myself, I can brief both honestly.

I am looking for an Account Manager, Account Supervisor, Project Manager, or Brand Manager role.
